modules.intro: Due end of the writing session. The criteria are read against this text.
modules.title: Engineering Report
modules.aiNote: AI can draft and tighten your writing and help build slides. Every number, property, and part number is checked against the page it came from.

blocks.content:
Four sections and a record trace. Do not paste your checkpoint work in whole.

Every published property you name carries the exact part number it came from. A property with no part number behind it cannot be checked and does not earn credit.

Sources: IDEA209H syllabus v4; approved IDEA209 course description, Unit 1.

blocks.prompt: Results. Your five governing values with the method behind each: holding torque, reduction, which requirement governed it, shaft load, load per bolt with factor of safety. No arithmetic.

Selection justification. Each component on your BOM: the exact part number, the published property you selected against, its value, and where on that part's page you read it. "Appropriate" is not a justification.
BOM status. What changed since Checkpoint 2 and why. Give the load per bolt you submitted on Checkpoint 1, whether or not it was right. Flag any line missing a vendor, part number, or quantity.
Trade-offs. One candidate you rejected and recorded in your notebook, what it lost on, and what would have to change for it to win.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: All four sections are present and each one answers everything its prompt asked for.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four sections are present; one section omits one item its prompt asked for.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One section is missing or empty, or two or more sections omit an item they asked for.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Two or more sections are missing or empty.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every published property carries its value, the exact part number it was read from, and a record trace row naming the notebook page and date it was first written down.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One property is missing its part number, or one record trace row is missing its page or date.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or three properties cannot be traced to a part number, or the record trace is present but fewer than three rows carry a page and date.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Four or more properties carry no part number, or the record trace is empty, or no notebook page named in it exists in the collected notebook.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A reader who has not seen the checkpoints can follow the report on one read.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One passage has to be reread or guessed at, but the rest follows.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: The report cannot be followed without asking the writer what was meant.

customChecks.name: record-trace-complete
customChecks.description: Every row of the record trace has a notebook page and a date, and the pages exist in the notebook collected at the end of the unit.

modules.intro: Slides due with the report. The 15 points are scored live in your slot.
modules.title: Slides, Presentation, and Defense
modules.aiNote: Level 2 applies to building the slides. Every fact on them traces to the source your report cites, not to what AI recalls. The defense itself is unaided, enforced by the setting.

blocks.content:
Four slides, one per report section. Set sharing so anyone with the link can open it. A link nobody can open is a missing submission.

Worked example: Unit 1 Sample Slides. Built on the practice mechanism, not yours.

Your slot is 5:30 on a visible timer.

| | Min | Max |
|---|---|---|
| Open your link | | 0:30 |
| Present | 2:00 | 3:00 |
| Questions | | 2:00 |

3:00 is a hard stop and you are cut off at it. Under 2:00 means you have not covered six components, and the criteria below will show that. Practice against a timer.

Questions come from the class and the instructor. One of them is chosen from your own report, on whichever claim is least well sourced. What the criteria read:

| Criterion | Max | Read against |
|---|---|---|
| Selection rationale | 5 | Report section 2 |
| Defends every value | 6 | Report section 1 |
| Responds to questions | 4 | Whatever is asked |

Saying you do not know a value and naming where you would look it up counts as an answer. Inventing one does not.

A value or decision you cannot defend comes back as a comment on this assignment in IDEA Classroom, due end of the same day. That section's share of the 15 points is held until it is in.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Presents every component on the bill of materials, naming for each the published property it was selected against and that property's value.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Presents every component but leaves the governing property unnamed on one, or names properties throughout while omitting one component.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Presents at least half the components, with the governing property named on fewer than half of those presented.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Presents fewer than half the components, or does not present.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: For each of the five governing values, states the method and the inputs it was run on when asked, and the stated value matches the report.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Defends four of the five with method and inputs; one is restated without a method, or its value disagrees with the report.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Defends two or three of the five with method and inputs; the rest are asserted with no method stated.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Defends fewer than two of the five, or does not present.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Answers every question with information not already in the presented section, or states the answer is not known and names where it would be looked up.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Answers all but one question with new information; one repeats what was already presented without adding to it.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Half or more of the answers repeat what was already presented, while at least one adds something new.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No question is answered beyond a restatement, or no questions are taken.
